text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a modest gain felt good, but I should sell only when it fits my plan—not just to lock in a profit.","My account fell substantially while I made no trades; I should review each holding deliberately rather than assume that waiting or reacting to recent moves will help.","Because I check prices often and feel gains and losses strongly, I should set clear decision rules and avoid impulsive trades or holding solely to avoid realizing a loss."]}
